title: S0094 (2025 Regular): Sales or Transfers of Firearms to Persons Under 21 Years of Age

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Florida); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Florida text (Introduced, 2024-12-10; official copy, https://www.flsenate.gov/Session/Bill/2025/94/BillText/Filed/HTML (LegiScan doc 3031881))
provenance.note: Introduced version (filed 2024-12-10); later amendments are not in the text read. All of subsection (13) is struck: the under-21 purchase ban, the dealer sale/transfer ban, the third-degree felony penalty, and the exceptions for law enforcement, correctional officers and servicemembers (rifle or shotgun). Quote is only the amending line.

operative_text:
Section 1 (s. 790.065, F.S.): Subsection (13) of section 790.065, Florida Statutes, is amended to read: 790.065 Sale and delivery of firearms.—
Section 1 (s. 790.065(13), F.S.), words struck by the bill (the whole subsection is shown struck in the filed text; read from the saved official HTML 2026-11-22): (13) A person younger than 21 years of age may not purchase a firearm. The sale or transfer of a firearm to a person younger than 21 years of age may not be made or facilitated by a licensed importer, licensed manufacturer, or licensed dealer.
